title: [MTR4] American Heavy Freight Pack
description: Freight Trains for your American Railway
body:
The American Heavy Freight Pack is a Resource pack that adds American Freight Locomotives and Freight Cars to the Minecraft Transit Railway Mod.

EMD:
---
SD40-2 in CSX, NS, UP, BNSF, CN, and CPKC Liveries, and ATSF, SP, and CP (Canadian Pacific) Liveries.

GE:
---
GEVO in CSX, NS, UP, BSNF, CN, and CPKC Liveries

Freight Cars:
---
Autorack

Wellcar

Flatcar (With Center Beam and Bulkhead Variants)

Hopper Car

Boxcar

Notice:
---
This pack is not Affiliated with any Company shown in this Pack. Requires MTR 4.0.4 or Later.
